error_events.evidence: Delegates 'Find a reservation with origin ATL, destination PHL, and travel date April 5th' with no user id and no reservation id, after the customer said at step 3 'I don't have my reservation ID handy'. Every db read tool requires an id (get_user_details(user_id), get_reservation_details(reservation_id)); no tool searches reservations by route/date. The planner's own procedure step 1 is 'gather identifying details (user id, reservation id)' but it never once asks the customer for a user id in the whole conversation.

Calls get_user_details({'user_id': 'sara_doe_496'}) -> 'Error: user not found'. The id 'sara_doe_496' appears in no customer turn and in no part of the planner instruction (which named only ATL/PHL/April 5th); the db_agent system prompt states 'Do not invent data'.

Reports 'The user was not found in the system' without stating which id it queried (the invented 'sara_doe_496') and without saying that no available tool can look up a reservation by origin/destination/date; the planner consequently told the customer at step 7 'I couldn't find a reservation matching the details you provided', which no tool result supports.

Second db_agent delegation ('Find a reservation with origin ATL, destination PHL, travel date April 5th, and passenger name Aarav Garcia') still carries no user id or reservation id after the step-6 failure; the planner asks the customer for a name (step 7) rather than the user id its procedure requires.

Calls get_user_details({'user_id': 'aarav_garcia_123'}) -> 'Error: user not found'. The customer supplied only the name 'Aarav Garcia' at step 8; the id string with the '_123' suffix is invented, contrary to 'Do not invent data'.

Third identical idless delegation ('Search for a reservation with origin ATL, destination PHL, travel date April 5th, and passenger name Aarav Garcia'), issued after two db_agent reports that the lookup failed; still no request to the customer for a user id.
Repeats the identical failing call get_user_details({'user_id': 'aarav_garcia_123'}) already answered with 'Error: user not found' at step 10, with the same invented id and no new information.
Fourth delegation, worded as 'Perform a broader search ...', again without user id or reservation id; nothing in the instruction differs from steps 4/9/14 that would let the db_agent execute it.

Third repetition of get_user_details({'user_id': 'aarav_garcia_123'}) -> 'Error: user not found'; a 'broader search' was requested and no other tool (e.g. get_reservation_details) or clarification was attempted.

Fifth delegation adds only the booking channel ('booked through the airline's website'), which no db tool accepts as a search key, and still omits the user id / reservation id that every db read tool requires.

Fourth repetition of the same invented-id call get_user_details({'user_id': 'aarav_garcia_123'}) -> 'Error: user not found'; the added premise 'Booking source: Airline's website' is not usable by any tool and no different tool is tried.

Tells the customer 'you can retrieve your reservation details by logging into your account on our airline's website. Once logged in, navigate to "My Bookings" ... Alternatively, check your email for a confirmation message'. No tool result or policy statement mentions a website account, a 'My Bookings' page or confirmation emails; the planner's own system prompt forbids inventing information not obtained from db_agent / policy_checker, and the airline policy states the agent 'should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools'.
